description: Na₃SbTe₃ crystallizes in the cubic P2_13 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent Te atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing NaTe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-56°. There are three shorter (3.29 Å) and three longer (3.50 Å) Na-Te bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent Te atoms. There are three shorter (3.24 Å) and three longer (3.45 Å) Na-Te bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent Te atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing NaTe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-48°. There are three shorter (3.25 Å) and three longer (3.40 Å) Na-Te bond lengths. Sb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Te atoms. All Sb-Te bond lengths are 2.84 Å. Te is bonded to six Na and one Sb atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing TeNa₆Sb pentagonal bipyramids.
